# amm-ds / portfolio

> Reproducible ML/AI engineering portfolio: 13 end-to-end case studies under
> `projects/`, a FastAPI + React showcase (`apps/`), shared libraries
> (`libs/`), and an mkdocs site (`docs/`). Every public number traces to a
> committed artifact (`reports/metrics.json`) and re-runs from a clean clone
> via DVC pipelines.

## What this repository is

- Public portfolio + freelancing site. Owner: github.com/amm-ds.
- Each `projects/NN-*/` is one experiment: `portfolio.yaml` (registry card),
  `story.yaml` (case-study article), `src/`, `tests/`, `reports/` (committed
  metrics/figures), `DESIGN.md` (requirements/options/decision record),
  `dvc.yaml` (pipeline). Python 3.12, single uv workspace.
- `apps/showcase-api` (FastAPI) serves `/projects`, `/demos`, stories,
  figures, live demo endpoints, `POST /contact/unlock`.
  `apps/showcase-web` (Vite + React + TS) is the terminal-style SPA.
  `apps/agent-chat` is a lift-out-able pydantic-ai chatbot template with its
  own uv workspace, specs, and ADRs. `apps/document-intelligence` is an independent
  page-level PDF analysis workbench: one AI call per page produces cited
  summaries, typed entities, and topics, plus page-scoped cited chat, with
  parser-resolved evidence, a FastAPI + leased worker, Postgres, a React
  workbench, and page-level offline/live evaluation.

## How to run the gates

```bash
uv sync --all-packages --dev          # after dependency changes
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy libs projects apps
uv run pytest -q
uv run python scripts/lint_ci.py           # workflow YAML + Makefile + docs gate
uv run python scripts/check_docs.py        # markdown links, fenced-code languages, glossary anchors
uv run python scripts/lint_story_language.py
uv run python scripts/check_short_copy.py --check
uv run python scripts/check_demo_contract.py
uv run python scripts/gen_static_registry.py --check
uv run python scripts/gen_story_short.py --check
uv run python scripts/gen_route_manifest.py --check
cd apps/showcase-web && npm ci && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
uv run mkdocs build --strict
```

Agents do not run `uv sync`/`uv lock` or git mutations — the session owner does.

## Conventions that bite

- Truth in copy: numbers must exist in a committed artifact. `story.yaml:
  short_version` is the short-copy source; `gen_story_short.py` writes only
  `storyShort.ts`, while `check_short_copy.py --check` verifies the check-only
  README/docs surfaces.
- Generated registries (`staticRegistry.ts`, `storyShort.ts`,
  `route-manifest.json`, sitemap) are rebuilt by their scripts, never edited.
- The showcase API enumerates projects at startup — restart it after adding
  or renaming a project.
- Project READMEs follow one skeleton (What it is / Why / Quickstart /
  Results / Limits / Reproduce) and carry a `## Common errors` block with the
  first failure a new runner actually hits; see repo-conventions.md §Documentation.
- Docs filing follows Diátaxis: runbooks = how-to, ADRs = explanation,
  data-registry = reference. Copy rule: executable commands over
  click-directives; one concept per page; code samples first.
